headline: You're +0.74kg/week off target—catch up today
summary: You're gaining when you need to lose; today you attack with portion control and 45+ minutes of movement.
details: Your last 30 days show +0.4kg—the opposite direction you need. TODAY: stick to Huel portions, eliminate emotional snacking, no weekend foods starting now, and do 45–60 minutes on your rowing machine or treadmill to create the weekly deficit you need. This Tuesday decides your trajectory: continue the +0.4kg/month pattern or finally catch the -0.74kg/week pace to reach 88kg by June 2027.
